 </ol><p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family:
     &quot;PT Sans&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">The
     existing single rear extension and raised decking, by reason of their
     excessive cumulative depth, height and siting, as well as the extensive
     glazing sited immediately on the shared boundary, &nbsp;is detrimental to the amenities of the

     The London Plan (2021), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies
     Local Plan document (2013) and the relevant provisions of the adopted
     Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></span></p><ol start="1" type="1">
</ol>

     existing single storey rear extension, in conjunction with historic
